arabic text: TABOOTAY HASSAN PAR HAI, KIYU TEERON KA SIYA HAI
english translation text: WOE! WHY IS THERE A SHADOW OF ARROWS OVER HASSAN’S COFFIN?

arabic text: PEH-CHANOO MUSLAMANO, YE ZAHRA KA JAYA HAI
english translation text: RECOGNIZE OH MUSLIMS! THIS IS ZAHRA’S SON!

arabic text: ZAINAB KI AAHOW-ZAREE SE, KOHARAM MACHA HARSU
english translation text: FROM THE LAMENTATION OF ZAINAB, ARISES WAILING IN ALL DIRECTIONS

arabic text: NANA KI NISHANI KO, KIYU ZEHAR PILAYA HAI
english translation text: WHY HAS MY GRANDFATHER’S HEIR BEEN POISONED?

arabic text: LAY JAOO JANAZAY KO, YE KIS NE KAHA LOGO
english translation text: 'WHO ASKED YOU TO BURY THE COFFIN, O PEOPLE?'

arabic text: AHSAN RISALAT KA, TEERON SAY LUTAYA HAI
english translation text: 'NOW WE WILL RETURN THE FAVOUR OF PROPHETHOOD WITH ARROWS.'

arabic text: TUKARAY JIGGAR KAY TAMAY, KARBOBALA KI KHATIR\nQASIM KI JIWANI KO, TAWEEZ BANAYA HAI
english translation text: YOUR LIVER WAS TORN INTO PIECES FOR THE SAKE OF KARBALA\nYOU MADE QASIM'S YOUTH A TALISMAN OF SACRIFICE
